df-001: Chatbot model requests via OpenAI-compatible client (HTTP) df-001 authentication: LLM_API_KEY environment value passed to the provider client; evidence: routes/chat.ts:110
df-002: Challenge solution notification POST with CTF flag (HTTP)
df-003: Server-side fetch of user-supplied profile image URL (HTTP)

df-004: NFT mint and wallet exploit contract event subscriptions over WebSocket RPC (WebSocket) df-004 authentication: ALCHEMY_API_KEY embedded in the provider URL path; evidence: routes/nftMint.ts:18
df-005: Socket.IO connection for live server events (Socket.IO)

df-006: Sequelize queries to embedded SQLite file (SQLite) df-006 authentication: Embedded SQLite engine inside the application process; the engine has no login of its own.; evidence: models/index.ts:34

df-007: Login with email and password (HTTP) df-007 authentication: email and hashed password matched against Users table; TOTP second-factor token required if totpSecret is set; evidence: routes/login.ts:34

df-009: OAuth authorization (HTTPS) df-009 authentication: The identity provider authenticates the user at its sign-in endpoint; evidence: frontend/src/app/login/login.component.ts:31, frontend/src/app/login/login.component.ts:148
df-010: OAuth profile request (HTTPS) df-010 authentication: The provider checks the OAuth access token sent with the request; evidence: frontend/src/app/Services/user.service.ts:68

df-011: API requests (bearer) (HTTP) df-011 authentication: the handler checks a bearer credential and rejects the request without it; evidence: lib/insecurity.ts:178, lib/insecurity.ts:52, routes/orderHistory.ts:13, lib/insecurity.ts:156
df-012: API requests (unknown authentication) (HTTP) df-013: API requests (unknown authentication) (HTTP)

df-015: API requests (bearer) (HTTP) df-016: API requests (other) (HTTP) df-015 authentication: the handler checks a bearer credential and rejects the request without it; evidence: lib/insecurity.ts:178, lib/insecurity.ts:52 df-015 access group: API access; alternatives; step n/a df-016 authentication: the handler checks the supplied TOTP code against the account secret and rejects an invalid code; evidence: routes/2fa.ts:31 df-016 access group: API access; alternatives; step n/a

df-018: Direct requests (cookie) (HTTP) df-018 authentication: the handler checks a cookie credential and rejects the request without it; evidence: routes/profileImageFileUpload.ts:35, routes/profileImageUrlUpload.ts:21, routes/userProfile.ts:34, routes/updateUserProfile.ts:17, routes/dataErasure.ts:26, routes/dataErasure.ts:76

finding; +N = further labels, listed under Further capabilities.
